title: dns/deregister input
description: Input Contract for the dns/deregister Action (ADR-0144): remove an RRset from a zone. By (name, type) and NEVER by value — removing "the A record whose data is X" silently does nothing once the data has drifted, which is exactly when a removal matters. Idempotent: removing an absent RRset is a no-op success. Note the honest limit this Action exists inside — core has no facet-retraction path, so removing the record does not by itself retract the mgmt.address the Syncer already projected; it stops the zone from re-asserting it, and the removal is at least a deliberate act with a Run behind it (ADR-0144 D5).

name.description: The record's owner name, bare or qualified within the zone.
